terms.definition: Tempat berlabuh adalah fasilitas sementara yang dibuat untuk mendukung pasukan, berfungsi sebagai basis untuk proyeksi kekuatan.
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings, radio, and reports.

examples.text: Tempat berlabuh harus disiapkan untuk pesawat yang akan datang.
examples.english: Force beddown must be prepared for the incoming aircraft.

examples.text: Kami akan menyediakan tempat berlabuh bagi pasukan.
examples.english: We will provide force beddown for the troops.

terms.definitionEn: An advanced naval base for the anchoring, fueling, and refitting of transports and cargo ships and for replenishment of mobile service squadrons.
terms.definition: Basis penyediaan adalah basis angkatan laut maju untuk penambatan, pengisian bahan bakar, dan perbaikan transportasi dan kapal kargo, serta pengisian ulang skadron pelayanan bergerak.
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: Basis penyediaan harus disiapkan sebelum operasi dimulai.
examples.english: Staging base must be prepared before the operation starts.

examples.text: Kami akan menggunakan basis penyediaan untuk logistik.
examples.english: We will use the staging base for logistics.

terms.definitionEn: An Army team used to decentralize the execution of movement responsibilities on an area basis or at key transportation nodes. Also called MCT.
terms.definition: Tim pengendalian gerakan adalah tim Angkatan Darat yang digunakan untuk mendecentralisasi eksekusi tanggung jawab gerakan berdasarkan wilayah atau di titik transportasi penting.
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings, radio, and reports.

examples.text: Tim pengendalian gerakan akan mengkoordinasikan transportasi.
examples.english: Movement control team will coordinate transportation.

examples.text: Kami akan menyediakan tim pengendalian gerakan untuk operasi ini.
examples.english: We will provide a movement control team for this operation.

terms.termEn: contractors authorized to accompany the force (CAAF)
terms.definitionEn: Contractor employees issued a letter of authorization to accompany the joint force in applicable contingency operations outside of the United States. Also called CAAF.
terms.term: kontraktor yang diberi izin untuk mengikuti pasukan

equivalents.text: kontraktor yang diberi izin untuk mengikuti pasukan

terms.definition: Kontraktor yang diberi izin untuk mengikuti pasukan adalah karyawan kontraktor yang diberi surat izin untuk mengikuti pasukan gabungan dalam operasi kontingen di luar Amerika Serikat.
terms.registerNote: Used in liaison and reports.

examples.text: Kontraktor yang diberi izin untuk mengikuti pasukan harus terdaftar.
examples.english: Contractors authorized to accompany the force must be registered.

examples.text: Kami akan memverifikasi kontraktor yang diberi izin untuk mengikuti pasukan.
examples.english: We will verify contractors authorized to accompany the force.

collocations: kontraktor yang diberi izin untuk mengikuti pasukan verifikasi
memverifikasi kontraktor yang diberi izin untuk mengikuti pasukan
memerlukan kontraktor yang diberi izin untuk mengikuti pasukan

terms.definitionEn: The rapid movement of personnel, materiel, and forces to and from, or within, a theater by air.
terms.definition: Mobilitas udara adalah gerakan cepat personel, peralatan, dan pasukan ke, dari, atau dalam teater dengan menggunakan udara.
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings, radio, and reports.

examples.text: Mobilitas udara akan memungkinkan transportasi cepat.
examples.english: Air mobility will enable fast transportation.

examples.text: Kami akan menggunakan mobilitas udara untuk operasi ini.
examples.english: We will use air mobility for this operation.

terms.definitionEn: Airlift conducted within a theater with forces assigned to a combatant commander or attached to a subordinate joint force commander.
terms.definition: Angkutan udara intrateater adalah angkutan udara yang dilakukan dalam teater dengan pasukan yang ditugaskan kepada panglima perang atau ditugaskan kepada komandan gabungan bawahannya.
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and radio communications.

examples.text: Penerbangan angkutan udara intrateater akan berangkat dalam 30 menit.
examples.english: Intratheater airlift will depart in 30 minutes.

examples.text: Angkutan udara intrateater telah selesai mengangkut pasokan ke markas.
examples.english: Intratheater airlift has finished transporting supplies to the base.

terms.definitionEn: The unloading of personnel or materiel from aircraft in flight.
terms.definition: Pengentasan udara adalah proses memunggah personel atau peralatan dari pesawat saat terbang.
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: Pasukan akan melakukan pengentasan udara di zona penumpangan.
examples.english: Troops will perform an airdrop at the landing zone.

examples.text: Barang persediaan akan dientaskan udara ke pos terdepan.
examples.english: Supplies will be airdropped to the forward outpost.

terms.definitionEn: Any person who is lost to the organization by having been declared dead, duty status – whereabouts unknown, excused absence – whereabouts unknown, missing, ill, or injured.
terms.definition: Korban adalah setiap orang yang hilang dari organisasi karena dinyatakan meninggal, status tugas – tempat tidak diketahui, absen terima kasih – tempat tidak diketahui, hilang, sakit, atau terluka.
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: Tim medis akan mengevaluasi korban sebelum evakuasi.
examples.english: Medical team will assess casualties before evacuation.

examples.text: Jumlah korban yang ditangani oleh tim medis telah meningkat.
examples.english: The number of casualties handled by the medical team has increased.

terms.definitionEn: The unregulated movement of casualties aboard any vehicle. Also called CASEVAC.
terms.definition: Evakuasi korban adalah gerakan tak teratur korban dengan menggunakan kendaraan apapun.
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and radio communications.

examples.text: Evakuasi korban akan dilakukan menggunakan helikopter.
examples.english: Casualty evacuation will be conducted using a helicopter.

examples.text: Tim CASEVAC telah siap untuk mengangkut korban.
examples.english: CASEVAC team is ready to transport casualties.

terms.definitionEn: The movement of patients under medical supervision to and between medical treatment facilities by air transportation. Also called AE.
terms.definition: Evakuasi aeromedis adalah gerakan pasien di bawah pengawasan medis ke dan antara fasilitas perawatan medis dengan menggunakan transportasi udara.
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: Evakuasi aeromedis akan mengevaluasi status pasien sebelum penerbangan.
examples.english: Aeromedical evacuation will assess patient status before flight.

examples.text: Penerbangan AE akan membawa pasien ke fasilitas perawatan medis.
examples.english: AE flight will transport the patient to the medical treatment facility.

terms.definitionEn: Any number of human casualties produced across a period of time that exceeds available medical support capabilities.
terms.definition: Korban jiwa massal adalah jumlah korban manusia yang melebihi kemampuan dukungan medis yang tersedia dalam waktu tertentu. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: Situasi korban jiwa massal telah diaktifkan di daerah tersebut.
examples.english: Mass casualty situation has been activated in that area.

examples.text: Tim medis telah dilatih untuk menangani korban jiwa massal.
examples.english: Medical team has been trained to handle mass casualties.

terms.definitionEn: The characterization of health support for the distribution of medical resources and capabilities.
terms.definition: Peran perawatan medis adalah karakterisasi dukungan kesehatan untuk mendistribusikan sumber daya dan kemampuan medis. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: Peran perawatan medis telah ditentukan untuk misi ini.
examples.english: Roles of medical care have been determined for this mission.

examples.text: Tim medis akan melaksanakan peran perawatan medis di lapangan.
examples.english: Medical team will carry out the roles of medical care in the field.

terms.definitionEn: A facility established for the purpose of furnishing medical and/or dental care to eligible individuals. Also called MTF.
terms.definition: Fasilitas perawatan medis adalah tempat yang didirikan untuk memberikan perawatan medis dan/atau dental kepada individu yang berhak. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: Fasilitas perawatan medis akan menerima pasien dalam waktu dekat.
examples.english: Medical treatment facility will receive patients shortly.

examples.text: MTF telah siap untuk menangani pasien baru.
examples.english: MTF is ready to handle new patients.

terms.definitionEn: The deliberate integration of tactics and medicine to treat casualties during combat. Also called TCCC.
terms.definition: Perawatan korban tempur taktis adalah integrasi taktik dan medis untuk merawat korban selama pertempuran. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: Tim medis akan melaksanakan perawatan korban tempur taktis di lapangan.
examples.english: Medical team will carry out tactical combat casualty care in the field.

examples.text: Pelatihan TCCC telah diselesaikan oleh seluruh tim medis.
examples.english: TCCC training has been completed by the entire medical team.

terms.definitionEn: Actions to prevent, identify, and manage adverse combat and operational stress reactions. Also called COSC.
terms.definition: Pengendalian tekanan tempur dan operasi adalah tindakan untuk mencegah, mengidentifikasi, dan mengelola reaksi tekanan tempur dan operasi yang negatif. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: Tim medis akan menerapkan pengendalian tekanan tempur dan operasi.
examples.english: Medical team will implement combat and operational stress control.

examples.text: Pelatihan COSC telah diselesaikan oleh seluruh tim medis.
examples.english: COSC training has been completed by the entire medical team.

terms.definitionEn: The coordination for the movement of patients to match patients with an appropriate medical treatment facility.
terms.definition: Regulasi medis adalah koordinasi pemindahan pasien untuk cocokkan mereka dengan fasilitas perawatan medis yang sesuai. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: Regulasi medis diperlukan untuk memastikan pasien dirawat di fasilitas yang tepat.
examples.english: Medical regulation is needed to ensure patients are treated at the appropriate facility.

examples.text: Penerbangan medis akan dilakukan sesuai dengan regulasi medis yang berlaku.
examples.english: Medical evacuation will be carried out in accordance with the applicable medical regulations.

terms.definitionEn: Mission-specific protective equipment provided to shield or isolate personnel from hazards. Also called PPE.
terms.definition: Peralatan pelindung pribadi adalah peralatan pelindung yang spesifik untuk misi yang diberikan untuk melindungi atau mengisolasi personel dari bahaya. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and safety instructions.

examples.text: Semua personel harus menggunakan peralatan pelindung pribadi saat beroperasi.
examples.english: All personnel must use personal protective equipment while operating.

examples.text: Peralatan pelindung pribadi akan disediakan sebelum misi dimulai.
examples.english: Personal protective equipment will be provided before the mission starts.

terms.definitionEn: Department of Defense activities conducted outside the United States and its territories to directly relieve or reduce human suffering, disease, hunger, or privation. Also called FHA.
terms.definition: Bantuan kemanusiaan luar negeri adalah kegiatan Departemen Pertahanan yang dilakukan di luar Amerika Serikat dan wilayahnya untuk langsung mengurangi atau mengurangi penderitaan manusia, penyakit, kelaparan, atau kekurangan. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and liaison communications.

examples.text: TNI-AU siap memberikan bantuan kemanusiaan luar negeri jika terjadi bencana.
examples.english: The Indonesian Air Force is ready to provide foreign humanitarian assistance if a disaster occurs.

examples.text: Bantuan kemanusiaan luar negeri akan dikirim melalui pesawat transportasi militer.
examples.english: Foreign humanitarian assistance will be sent via military transport aircraft.

terms.definitionEn: Assistance that can be used immediately to alleviate the suffering of foreign disaster victims that normally includes services and commodities, as well as the rescue and evacuation of victims; the provision and transportation of food, water, clothing, medicines, beds, bedding, and temporary shelter; the furnishing of medical equipment and medical and technical personnel; and making repairs to essential services. Also called FDR.
terms.definition: Bantuan bencana luar negeri adalah bantuan yang dapat digunakan segera untuk mengurangi penderitaan korban bencana di luar negeri yang biasanya termasuk layanan dan komoditas, serta penyelamatan dan evakuasi korban. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: Tim bantuan bencana luar negeri telah dipersiapkan untuk berangkat.
examples.english: The foreign disaster relief team has been prepared to depart.

examples.text: Bantuan bencana luar negeri akan difokuskan pada area paling terpengaruh.
examples.english: Foreign disaster relief will be focused on the most affected areas.

terms.definitionEn: A calamitous situation or event that occurs naturally or through human activities, which threatens or inflicts human suffering on a scale that may warrant emergency relief assistance from the United States Government or from foreign partners.
terms.definition: Bencana luar negeri adalah situasi atau peristiwa yang mengerikan yang terjadi secara alami atau melalui aktivitas manusia, yang mengancam atau menimbulkan penderitaan manusia pada skala yang mungkin memerlukan bantuan darurat dari Pemerintah Amerika Serikat atau dari mitra asing. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and liaison communications.

examples.text: Bencana luar negeri memerlukan koordinasi internasional untuk penanganan yang efektif.
examples.english: Foreign disasters require international coordination for effective management.

examples.text: TNI-AU akan memberikan bantuan jika bencana luar negeri terjadi.
examples.english: The Indonesian Air Force will provide assistance if a foreign disaster occurs.

terms.definitionEn: A situation that poses significant danger to life and property that results from a natural cause.
terms.definition: Bencana alam adalah situasi yang sangat membahayakan kehidupan dan properti akibat penyebab alami. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: Bencana alam seperti gempa bumi dapat menyebabkan kerusakan besar.
examples.english: Natural disasters such as earthquakes can cause significant damage.

examples.text: Penanggulangan bencana alam memerlukan kerjasama antara berbagai instansi.
examples.english: Mitigating natural disasters requires cooperation among various agencies.

terms.definitionEn: Assistance to the local populace, specifically authorized by Title 10, United States Code, Section 401, and funded under separate authorities, provided by predominantly United States forces in conjunction with military operations. Also called HCA.
terms.definition: Bantuan kemanusiaan dan sipil adalah bantuan yang diberikan oleh pasukan Amerika Serikat kepada penduduk setempat, yang diautorisasi dan dibiayai oleh otoritas tertentu. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and liaison communications.

examples.text: Bantuan kemanusiaan dan sipil akan diberikan kepada penduduk setempat.
examples.english: Humanitarian and civic assistance will be provided to the local population.

examples.text: Program bantuan kemanusiaan dan sipil akan dilaksanakan secara teratur.
examples.english: Humanitarian and civic assistance programs will be carried out regularly.

terms.definitionEn: An international and interagency body that coordinates the overall relief strategy and unity of effort among all participants in a large foreign humanitarian assistance operation. Also called HOC.
terms.definition: Pusat operasi kemanusiaan adalah badan internasional yang mengkoordinasikan strategi bantuan dan kerjasama antara semua peserta dalam operasi bantuan kemanusiaan besar. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: Pusat operasi kemanusiaan akan koordinasi seluruh upaya penanganan bencana.
examples.english: The humanitarian operations center will coordinate all disaster response efforts.

examples.text: TNI-AU akan bekerja sama dengan pusat operasi kemanusiaan.
examples.english: The Indonesian Air Force will cooperate with the humanitarian operations center.

terms.definitionEn: A temporary center established by a geographic combatant commander to assist with interagency coordination and planning during the early planning and coordination stages of foreign humanitarian assistance operations. Also called HACC.
terms.definition: Pusat koordinasi bantuan kemanusiaan adalah pusat sementara yang didirikan oleh panglima perang geografis untuk membantu koordinasi dan perencanaan antara agen dalam tahap awal operasi bantuan kemanusiaan luar negeri. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and liaison communications.

examples.text: Pusat koordinasi bantuan kemanusiaan akan dibentuk untuk memfasilitasi perencanaan.
examples.english: A humanitarian assistance coordination center will be established to facilitate planning.

examples.text: TNI-AU akan memberikan dukungan kepada pusat koordinasi bantuan kemanusiaan.
examples.english: The Indonesian Air Force will support the humanitarian assistance coordination center.

terms.definitionEn: A team deployed by the United States Agency for International Development, if a large-scale, urgent, and/or extended response is necessary, to provide specialists to assist the chief of mission and the United States Agency for International Development mission (where present) with the management of the United States Government response to a disaster. Also called DART.
terms.definition: Tim tanggap bencana adalah tim yang dikirim oleh United States Agency for International Development untuk memberikan ahli dalam manajemen tanggap bencana jika diperlukan. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: Tim tanggap bencana telah dilengkapi dengan peralatan yang diperlukan.
examples.english: The disaster assistance response team has been equipped with the necessary tools.

examples.text: Tim tanggap bencana akan segera berangkat ke lokasi bencana.
examples.english: The disaster assistance response team will soon depart for the disaster location.

terms.definitionEn: The withdrawal of civilians and noncombatants from a threatened area abroad that is carried out with the assistance of the Department of Defense. Also called NEO.
terms.definition: Operasi evakuasi non-kombatan (OENK) adalah penarikan warga sipil dan non-kombatan dari area yang terancam di luar negeri dengan bantuan Departemen Pertahanan. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in military briefings and reports.

examples.text: Operasi OENK akan dilakukan untuk menyelamatkan warga negara asing di daerah konflik.
examples.english: Noncombatant evacuation operation will be conducted to rescue foreign nationals in conflict area.

examples.text: Tim OENK siap melaksanakan evakuasi warga sipil dari wilayah berbahaya.
examples.english: NEO team ready to conduct evacuation of civilians from dangerous area.

terms.definitionEn: An organization established by a joint force commander to plan and facilitate coordination of activities of the Armed Forces of the United States within local populations and institutions, the private sector, international organizations, nongovernmental organizations, multinational forces, and other governmental agencies. Also called CMOC.
terms.definition: Pusat operasi sipil-militer (POSMIL) adalah organisasi yang didirikan oleh panglima pasukan gabungan untuk merencanakan dan memfasilitasi koordinasi aktivitas antara pasukan Amerika Serikat dengan berbagai pihak. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in formal military coordination and reports.

examples.text: POSMIL akan koordinasi bantuan humaniter antara pihak sipil dan militer.
examples.english: CMOC will coordinate humanitarian assistance between civil and military parties.

examples.text: Pihak militer bekerja sama dengan POSMIL untuk memastikan bantuan tepat sasaran.
examples.english: Military works with CMOC to ensure aid is targeted.

terms.definitionEn: A broad term primarily used by the Department of Defense that includes a displaced person, an evacuee, an internally displaced person, a migrant, a refugee, or a stateless person. Also called DC.
terms.definition: Warga sipil terpisah (WST) adalah istilah yang mencakup berbagai jenis orang yang terpisah dari tempat tinggal mereka akibat berbagai alasan. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in military and humanitarian aid contexts.

examples.text: WST perlu bantuan untuk kembali ke daerah asal mereka.
examples.english: Dislocated civilians need assistance to return to their home area.

examples.text: Pemerintah akan memberikan bantuan kepada WST yang terpengaruh oleh bencana.
examples.english: Government will provide assistance to DCs affected by disaster.

terms.definitionEn: 1. Transfer of a patient to or between medical treatment facilities.
terms.definition: Evakuasi adalah pindahan pasien ke atau antara fasilitas perawatan medis. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in medical and emergency contexts.

examples.text: Evakuasi pasien akan dilakukan dengan helikopter ke fasilitas medis terdekat.
examples.english: Patient evacuation will be conducted by helicopter to the nearest medical facility.

examples.text: Tim evakuasi siap melaksanakan tugas mereka untuk menyelamatkan korban.
examples.english: Evacuation team ready to perform their duties to save victims.

terms.definitionEn: Activities that strive to reduce the social, economic, and environmental impact of land mines, unexploded ordnance, and small arms ammunition. Also called HMA.
terms.definition: Tindakan humaniter anti ranjau (THAR) adalah kegiatan yang bertujuan untuk mengurangi dampak sosial, ekonomi, dan lingkungan dari ranjau darat, amunisi tak terdetonasi, dan amunisi senjata ringan. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in military and humanitarian demining operations.

examples.text: THAR akan membersihkan ranjau darat di daerah tersebut untuk memastikan keselamatan warga.
examples.english: HMA will clear landmines in the area to ensure the safety of civilians.

examples.text: Tim THAR bekerja keras untuk mengurangi dampak ranjau darat pada masyarakat.
examples.english: HMA team works hard to reduce the impact of landmines on the community.

terms.definitionEn: Fuel state above BINGO at which separation, BUGOUT, or event termination should begin.
terms.definition: JOKER adalah keadaan bahan bakar di atas BINGO di mana pemisahan, BUGOUT, atau penutupan acara harus dimulai.
terms.registerNote: Used in aviation radio communications.

examples.text: JOKER
examples.english: JOKER: Fuel state above BINGO at which separation, BUGOUT, or event termination should begin.

examples.text: JOKER
examples.english: If you reach JOKER, initiate separation procedures immediately.

terms.definitionEn: No ordnance remaining.
terms.definition: WINCHESTER berarti tidak ada lagi persenjataan yang tersisa.
terms.registerNote: Used in aviation radio communications.

examples.text: WINCHESTER
examples.english: WINCHESTER: No ordnance remaining.

examples.text: WINCHESTER
examples.english: We have reached WINCHESTER, returning to base.

terms.definitionEn: A request to provide information pertinent to the mission in a digital bullseye format unless briefed otherwise.
terms.definition: PICTURE adalah permintaan untuk memberikan informasi yang relevan dengan misi dalam format digital bullseye, kecuali yang telah dibriefkan sebaliknya.
terms.registerNote: Used in aviation radio communications.

examples.text: PICTURE
examples.english: PICTURE: A request to provide information pertinent to the mission in a digital bullseye format unless briefed otherwise.

examples.text: PICTURE
examples.english: Send PICTURE update for the current mission.

terms.definitionEn: Inquiry as to the ID of specified track(s), target(s), or correlated GROUP. Responses may include: FRIENDLY, BOGEY, BANDIT, HOSTILE, NEUTRAL, UNABLE, CLEAN, or FURBALL. Full positional data (BULLSEYE) or TRACK NUMBER must accompany responses.
terms.definition: DECLARE adalah pertanyaan tentang identifikasi dari rintisan, sasaran, atau kelompok yang ditentukan, dengan respon mungkin termasuk: SAHABAT, BOGEY, BANDIT, MUSUH, NETRAL, TIDAK DAPAT, CLEAN, atau FURBALL.
terms.registerNote: Used in aviation radio communications.

examples.text: DECLARE
examples.english: DECLARE: Inquiry as to the ID of specified track(s), target(s), or correlated GROUP. Responses may include: FRIENDLY, BOGEY, BANDIT, HOSTILE, NEUTRAL, UNABLE, CLEAN, or

examples.text: DECLARE
examples.english: DECLARE the ID of the target ahead.

terms.definitionEn: 1. [A/A] No sensor information on a GROUP of interest. 2. No visible battle damage. 3. Aircraft not carrying external stores.
terms.definition: CLEAN berarti tidak ada informasi sensor tentang kelompok yang dipertimbangkan, tidak ada kerusakan yang terlihat, atau pesawat tidak membawa persenjataan eksternal.
terms.registerNote: Used in aviation radio communications.

examples.text: CLEAN
examples.english: CLEAN: 1. [A/A] No sensor information on a GROUP of interest. 2. No visible battle damage. 3. Aircraft not carrying external stores.

examples.text: CLEAN
examples.english: The area is CLEAN, no targets detected.

terms.definitionEn: No visual contact with FRIENDLY aircraft, ship, or ground position. Opposite of VISUAL.
terms.definition: BLIND berarti tidak ada kontak visual dengan pesawat, kapal, atau posisi darat SAHABAT.
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communication to indicate lack of visual contact.

examples.text: Kami saat ini BLIND terhadap posisi tembak di area target.
examples.english: We are currently BLIND to the firing position in the target area.

examples.text: Pesawat kami BLIND karena kondisi cuaca yang buruk.
examples.english: Our aircraft is BLIND due to bad weather conditions.

terms.definitionEn: Sighting of a FRIENDLY aircraft or ground position or ship. Opposite of BLIND.
terms.definition: VISUAL berarti pengamatan pesawat, posisi darat, atau kapal SAHABAT.
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communication to indicate visual contact.

examples.text: Kami VISUAL dengan pesawat tempur di sebelah kiri.
examples.english: We have VISUAL contact with the fighter aircraft to our left.

examples.text: Markas kami VISUAL dengan posisi tembak di darat.
examples.english: Our base has VISUAL contact with the ground firing position.

terms.definitionEn: Cease action or terminate the attack prior to weapons release or event or mission.
terms.definition: BATAL berarti berhenti melakukan aksi atau menghentikan serangan sebelum melepaskan senjata atau acara atau misi.
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and radio communication to terminate an action.

examples.text: Serangan harus BATAL karena perubahan misi.
examples.english: The attack must be ABORTED due to a change in mission.

examples.text: Pesawat harus BATAL lepas senjata karena ancaman baru.
examples.english: The aircraft must ABORT weapons release due to a new threat.

terms.definitionEn: Immediate pause of direct or indirect fires. May require coordination to continue.
terms.definition: CEK TEMBAK berarti pause segera dari tembakan langsung atau tidak langsung.
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communication to pause fires, may require coordination.

examples.text: Semua unit harus CEK TEMBAK segera.
examples.english: All units must CHECK FIRE immediately.

examples.text: CEK TEMBAK sebelum melanjutkan misi.
examples.english: CHECK FIRE before continuing the mission.

terms.definitionEn: An emergency fire control order to stop firing on a designated target and destroy missiles in flight. NOTE CEASE FIRE does not destroy missiles in flight.
terms.definition: TINGGAL TEMBAK adalah perintah pengendalian tembak darurat untuk berhenti menembak pada sasaran yang ditentukan dan menghancurkan rudal yang sedang terbang.
terms.registerNote: Emergency fire control order used in radio communication.

examples.text: TINGGAL TEMBAK karena ancaman terhadap pasukan kami!
examples.english: HOLD FIRE due to a threat to our troops!

examples.text: TINGGAL TEMBAK dan hancurkan rudal yang sedang terbang.
examples.english: HOLD FIRE and destroy missiles in flight.

terms.definitionEn: 1. Record the location of a point or object of interest. 2. ** [A/S] [S/S] Spotting round, normally white phosphorus or illumination on the deck to indicate targets to aircraft, ground troops, or fire support. 3. ** [A/A] Challenge and response term for requested aircraft to report contrails.
terms.definition: Menandai lokasi titik atau objek yang penting atau peluru yang dilemparkan untuk menunjukkan sasaran kepada pesawat, pasukan darat, atau dukungan tembakan
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and radio communication to record a location.

examples.text: MARK lokasi pesawat musuh untuk pemantauan lebih lanjut.
examples.english: MARK the location of the enemy aircraft for further monitoring.

examples.text: MARK dengan tembakan spotting untuk menandai target.
examples.english: MARK with a spotting round to indicate the target.

terms.definitionEn: Radar electromagnetic deceptive jamming.
terms.definition: Pengecaman radar yang menggunakan gangguan elektromagnetik untuk mengelabui musuh
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and radio communication to indicate radar jamming.

examples.text: Kami mendeteksi MUSIC dari radar musuh.
examples.english: We have detected MUSIC from the enemy radar.

examples.text: MUSIC mengganggu sistem navigasi kami.
examples.english: MUSIC is jaming our navigation system.

terms.definitionEn: Electromagnetic communications jamming. NOTE Same as North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) term, CHATTER
terms.definition: Gangguan komunikasi elektromagnetik
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and radio communication to indicate communications jamming.

examples.text: Kami mendeteksi BUZZER pada frekuensi komunikasi.
examples.english: We have detected BUZZER on the communication frequency.

examples.text: BUZZER mengganggu komunikasi antara satuan.
examples.english: BUZZER is jaming communication between units.

terms.definitionEn: Radar indication(s) of noise jamming.
terms.definition: Tanda radar yang menunjukkan gangguan suara
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and radio communication to indicate noise jamming.

examples.text: Radar kami menampilkan STROBE akibat pengeboman musuh.
examples.english: Our radar shows STROBE due to enemy jamming.

examples.text: STROBE mengganggu deteksi radar kami.
examples.english: STROBE is jaming our radar detection.

terms.definitionEn: No radar warning receiver indications. unable to engage specified target (e.g., EAGLES NEGATE). Opposite of AFFIRM.
terms.definition: Tidak ada indikasi dari penerima peringatan radar dan tidak dapat menyerang sasaran yang ditentukan
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communication to indicate no radar warning receiver indications.

examples.text: Kami NAKED, tidak ada indikasi dari RWR.
examples.english: We are NAKED, no indications from the RWR.

examples.text: Tidak bisa menyerang target karena kami NAKED.
examples.english: Unable to engage the target because we are NAKED.

terms.definitionEn: Call to execute launch and leave tactics at a prebriefed range. Modifiers include LONG, SHORT, or QUICK.
terms.definition: Perintah untuk meluncurkan dan meninggalkan taktik di jarak yang telah diatur sebelumnya
terms.registerNote: Used in prebriefs and radio communications.

examples.text: SKATE LONG untuk misi ini, tim.
examples.english: "Execute LONG SKATE for this mission, team."

examples.text: Pesawat harus melaksanakan SKATE QUICK, siapkan diri.
examples.english: "Aircraft must perform QUICK SKATE, be ready."

terms.definitionEn: Fly at maximum continuous speed.
terms.definition: Terbang dengan kecepatan maksimum yang dapat dipertahankan
terms.registerNote: Common in radio communications for speed commands.

examples.text: Pesawat 1, BUSTER untuk mengejar target.
examples.english: "Aircraft 1, fly at BUSTER speed to chase the target."

examples.text: Tim, BUSTER sekarang untuk mencapai titik rencanan.
examples.english: "Team, BUSTER now to reach the planned point."

terms.definitionEn: Fly as quickly as possible, using after-burner or maximum power.
terms.definition: Terbang dengan kecepatan maksimum menggunakan afterburner atau daya maksimum
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications for urgent speed commands.

examples.text: GATE untuk menghindari ancaman, sekarang!
examples.english: "GATE to evade the threat, now!"

examples.text: Pesawat harus GATE untuk mencapai zona aman.
examples.english: "Aircraft must GATE to reach the safe zone."

terms.definitionEn: Switch to designated frequency; no acknowledgment required.
terms.definition: Beralih ke frekuensi yang ditentukan tanpa memerlukan pengakuan
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications for frequency changes.

examples.text: Tim, PUSH ke frekuensi 124.5.
examples.english: "Team, PUSH to frequency 124.5."

examples.text: PUSHPUSH ke frekuensi baru untuk koordinasi.
examples.english: "PUSHPUSH to the new frequency for coordination."

terms.definitionEn: 1. [A/A] Fighter request for immediate BRAA call (with appropriate fill-ins) to the GROUP described. Indicates fighter intent to intercept or join. 2. [heading] Urgent directive call to turn to a heading. a radar contact inside briefed threat range with BEAM, FLANK, or HOT aspect and is unable to complete sanitization responsibilities implying ownership. A SNAPLOCK call should be responded to with BRAA.
terms.definition: Permintaan untuk panggilan BRAA segera atau perintah untuk belok ke arah tertentu dengan segera
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications for direction changes.

examples.text: SNAP 360 untuk bergabung dengan grup.
examples.english: "SNAP 360 to join the group."

examples.text: Pesawat 2, SNAP 180 untuk interogasi.
examples.english: "Aircraft 2, SNAP 180 for interrogation."

terms.definitionEn: 1. [A/S] Acquisition of the reflected laser energy. 2. Platform is laser spot tracker capable.
terms.definition: SPOT adalah pengambilan energi laser yang dipantulkan.
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and radio communications.

examples.text: SPOT laser pada target, siap menembak.
examples.english: "SPOT laser on target, ready to fire."

examples.text: Pesawat ini dilengkapi dengan SPOT tracker.
examples.english: "This aircraft is equipped with a SPOT tracker."

terms.definitionEn: 1. Sensor information at the stated position. 2. [A/S] Acknowledges sighting of a specified reference point (either visually or via sensor). 3. [A/A] Individual radar return within a GROUP or ARM.
terms.definition: CONTACT adalah informasi sensor pada posisi yang ditentukan atau pengakuan penglihatan titik referensi tertentu.
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and radio communications.

examples.text: Kontak di koordinat 123, tim.
examples.english: "CONTACT at coordinates 123, team."

examples.text: Tim, sudah melihat titik referensi?
examples.english: "Team, do you see the reference point?"

terms.definitionEn: Loss of host radar or IR lock-on.
terms.definition: LOST LOCK adalah kehilangan lock-on radar atau IR dari target.
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and radio communications.

examples.text: Pesawat melaporkan LOST LOCK pada target.
examples.english: "Aircraft reports LOST LOCK on target."

examples.text: Radar kehilangan lock, tim.
examples.english: "Radar lost lock, team."

terms.definitionEn: Sensor data is lost on GROUP or CONTACT. Requires information of last known position to include number of CONTACTS and TRACK direction.
terms.definition: FADED adalah kehilangan data sensor pada GROUP atau CONTACT, memerlukan informasi posisi terakhir termasuk jumlah CONTACT dan arah TRACK.
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and radio communications.

examples.text: Sensor kehilangan data, tim.
examples.english: "Sensor data FADED, team."

examples.text: Kontak hilang, terakhir dilihat ke arah utara.
examples.english: "CONTACT lost, last seen heading north."

terms.definitionEn: 1. [A/S] Starting climb for A/S attack. 2. [A/A] Maximum performance climb out of lowaltitude structure.
terms.definition: POP adalah awal kenaikan untuk serangan A/S atau kenaikan maksimum performa dari struktur ketinggian rendah.
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and radio communications.

examples.text: Pesawat mulai POP untuk serangan.
examples.english: "Aircraft starts POP for attack."

examples.text: POP untuk keluar dari struktur rendah.
examples.english: "POP to exit low-altitude structure."

terms.definitionEn: Sort responsibility within a GROUP has been met.
terms.definition: SORTED adalah tanggung jawab sort dalam sebuah GROUP telah terpenuhi.
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports to confirm task completion.

examples.text: Tugas SORTED grup telah diselesaikan.
examples.english: The SORTED group task has been completed.

examples.text: Konfirmasi SORTED grup sudah diterima.
examples.english: Confirmation of SORTED group received.

terms.definitionEn: 1. Request for an individual’s tactical situation. 2. * Request for amplifying information on current task or aircraft state (e.g., respond with WORKING, JONESING, CONTACT, CAPTURE, TARGETED, LOCKED, CLEAN, ENGAGED, FUEL (RED/YELLOW/GREEN), WEAPON (RED/YELLOW/GREEN) ready or plain English).
terms.definition: STATUS adalah permintaan situasi taktis seseorang atau informasi penjelasan tentang tugas atau keadaan pesawat saat ini.

examples.text: Beri STATUS pesawat sayap kanan.
examples.english: Give STATUS of the right wing aircraft.

examples.text: STATUS tugas saat ini?
examples.english: STATUS of current task?

terms.definitionEn: 1. ** [A/A] GROUP or CONTACTS direction of flight or movement. 2. ** [A/S] [S/S] Directive call assigning responsibility to an asset for maintaining sensor or visual observation of a defined object or area. 3. ** [A/S] Rotary-wing directive call to establish race track (e.g., “Taz 31, TRACK left). 4. ** [A/S] [AIR-MAR] Information call stating direction of vehicle or CONTACT in motion (e.g., TALLY TECHNICAL TRACK Northwest).

terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications to assign or confirm tracking responsibilities.

examples.text: TRACK grup musuh bergerak ke timur.
examples.english: TRACK enemy group moving east.

examples.text: TRACK kontak di sector lima.
examples.english: TRACK contact in sector five.

terms.definitionEn: Visual acquisition of a SAM in flight or a SAM launch; should include position.
terms.definition: SAM adalah penglihatan visual rudal permukaan-ke-udara (SAM) dalam penerbangan atau peluncuran SAM, termasuk posisi.
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications to report visual acquisition of SAM.

examples.text: SAM dilihat meluncur dari posisi Lima-Satu.
examples.english: SAM seen launching from position Lima-Satu.

examples.text: SAM terlihat di udara, posisi Lima-Dua.
examples.english: SAM seen in the air, position Lima-Dua.

terms.definitionEn: Untargeted HOSTILE, BANDIT, or BOGEY is within a briefed range of a FRIENDLY aircraft.
terms.definition: THREAT adalah musuh, bandit, atau musuh yang tidak ditargetkan dalam jangkauan yang disampaikan dekat dengan pesawat teman.
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and radio communications to report potential dangers.

examples.text: Ada THREAT dalam jangkauan pesawat kami.
examples.english: There is a THREAT within range of our aircraft.

examples.text: Pesawat musuh menjadi THREAT bagi pesawat teman.
examples.english: Enemy aircraft poses a THREAT to friendly aircraft.

terms.definitionEn: Call from an aircraft maneuvering in the visual arena to relinquish deconfliction responsibilities.
terms.definition: Panggilan dari pesawat yang bergerak di arena visual untuk melepaskan tanggung jawab dekonflik
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications during visual engagements.

examples.text: ENGAGED, saya akan berputar ke kanan.
examples.english: ENGAGED, I will turn right.

examples.text: ENGAGED, tanggung jawab deconfliction saya lepas.
examples.english: ENGAGED, I relinquish deconfliction responsibilities.

terms.definitionEn: 1. * [A/A] Intercept the GROUP(S) of interest. 2. * [A/A] Set briefed intercept geometry.
terms.definition: 1. [A/A] Tangkap GROUPS yang diminati. 2. [A/A] Atur geometri intercept yang telah disampaikan
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications to assign or confirm intercept tasks.

examples.text: COMMIT untuk intersep grup target.
examples.english: COMMIT to intercept the target group.

examples.text: COMMIT untuk membentuk geometri intersep.
examples.english: COMMIT to set intercept geometry.

terms.definitionEn: Maneuver to a position on opposite sides, either laterally or vertically from the target.
terms.definition: Manuver ke posisi di sisi berlawanan, baik secara lateral atau vertikal dari target
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and radio communications to describe maneuvering tactics.

examples.text: BRACKET target dari sisi kiri dan kanan.
examples.english: BRACKET target from left and right sides.

examples.text: Pesawat akan BRACKET target secara vertikal.
examples.english: Aircraft will BRACKET target vertically.

terms.definitionEn: Perform an immediate maximum performance turn in the indicated direction (default is a 180-degree turn).
terms.definition: Lakukan putaran maksimum segera ke arah yang ditunjukkan (default adalah putaran 180 derajat)
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications to direct immediate evasive maneuvers.

examples.text: BREAK kiri segera!
examples.english: BREAK left immediately!

examples.text: Pesawat diharapkan BREAK ke arah timur.
examples.english: Aircraft expected to BREAK east.

terms.definitionEn: In training, shooters are TALLY at assessed missile timeout.
terms.definition: Dalam pelatihan, penembak dihitung saat waktu habis peluru yang ditaksir
terms.registerNote: Used in training exercises to simulate successful engagements.

examples.text: Shooter KILL pada waktu timeout rudal.
examples.english: Shooter KILL at missile timeout.

examples.text: Dalam latihan, KILL diumumkan pada timeout.
examples.english: In training, KILL announced at timeout.

No further mission support from the FRIENDLY asset is expected. 2. ** [A/A] [S/A] [EW] Cease the intercept and take immediate evasive action. examples.text: Menara kontrol melaporkan SCRAM setelah radar mendeteksi misil.
examples.english: Control tower reports SCRAM after radar detects missile.

terms.definitionEn: Airborne threat has passed through a defensive layer. Call should include amplifying information.
terms.definition: Ancaman udara yang telah melewati lapisan pertahanan. Panggilan harus termasuk informasi tambahan
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and briefings to indicate airborne threat penetration.

examples.text: Radar menandai LEAKER setelah pesawat musuh melewati pertahanan udara.
examples.english: Radar marks LEAKER after enemy aircraft passes through air defense.

examples.text: LEAKER terkonfirmasi setelah ancaman melewati jaringan pertahanan.
examples.english: LEAKER confirmed after threat passes through defense network.

drills.explanation: That system of equipment, network, and personnel to control an unmanned aircraft. Also called UAS.
An aircraft that does not carry a human operator and is capable of flight with or without human remote control. Also called UA.
An unmanned aircraft system whose aircraft weighs less than 55 pounds, together with its ground control station and data links.
One of five size classes the US military uses for unmanned aircraft, from Group 1 (under 20 pounds, low and slow) to Group 5 (over 1,320 pounds, flying above 18,000 feet).
A small drone flown by an operator who watches a live video feed from its onboard camera, often through goggles, and often used as a guided explosive weapon.
Loitering munition is a reference to any UAS that can engage beyond line-of-sight ground targets with an explosive warhead or lethal payload to cause injury via a “suicide mode” attack. 1-8.
A group of unmanned aircraft that operate together under coordinated or automated control to overwhelm defenses or complete a shared task.
An aircraft that gets lift from wings that do not move, so it must keep moving forward to stay in the air.
An aircraft that gets lift from spinning rotor blades, so it can take off vertically and hover.
A drone lifted by several horizontal propellers (commonly four, six or eight) that lets it hover and change direction quickly.
The equipment, people and procedures used to detect, track, identify and defeat hostile or unauthorized unmanned aircraft.
A defense that places several sensors and weapons at different ranges so that a threat that gets past one layer can still be stopped by the next.
In counter-UAS, the first step: sensing that an aircraft or drone is present, by radar, radio-frequency, optical or acoustic sensors.
Precise and continuous position-finding of targets by radar, optical, or other means.

1. The process of determining the friendly or hostile character of an unknown detected contact. 2. In arms control, the process of determining which nation is responsible for the detected violations of any arms control measure. 3. In ground
In counter-UAS, the step that stops an unmanned aircraft from completing its mission, by destroying it, disabling it or taking control of it.
Stopping an unmanned aircraft by physically hitting it, for example with gunfire, a missile, an interceptor drone or a net.
Stopping an unmanned aircraft without physically hitting it, for example by jamming its control link or its satellite navigation.
Finding a drone by picking up the radio signals passing between it and its controller, which can also point to where the operator is.
A sensor that sends out radio waves and measures their echoes to find the position, speed and direction of objects such as aircraft.
A camera system that uses visible light and heat images to see, follow and identify a target by day or night.
A sensor that detects a drone by listening for the sound of its motors and propellers.
The employment of limited offensive action and counterattacks to deny a contested area or position to the enemy.
Measures taken to reduce the probability of and to minimize the effects of damage caused by hostile action without the intention of taking the initiative.

scenarios.title: BDOC shift handover
scenarios.situation: You are coming on shift in the base defense operations center. Your host-nation counterpart is going off shift and briefs you on the night: one drone sighting, a gate camera fault and a patrol still out.
scenarios.opener: Selamat pagi, saya sudah selesai shift. Malam ini ada satu pelaporan drone, kamera gerbang rusak, dan satu patrul masih di luar. Apa yang ingin Anda tanyakan?
scenarios.openerEnglish: "Good morning, my shift is over. Tonight there was one drone sighting, a gate camera fault, and one patrol still out. What would you like to ask?"

scenarios.title: Reporting a drone sighting up the chain
scenarios.situation: From an observation post you see a small multirotor drone hovering over the fuel point. Report it to the host-nation duty officer on the radio: what, where, direction, and what you are doing.
scenarios.opener: Kota, ini Observation Post 3. Saya melihat drone multirotor kecil mengapung di atas titik bahan bakar. Di mana aksi yang akan dilakukan?
scenarios.openerEnglish: "Base, this is Observation Post 3. I see a small multirotor drone hovering over the fuel point. What action will be taken?"

scenarios.title: Airspace coordination call with host-nation air defense
scenarios.situation: Your unit will fly a small surveillance drone this afternoon. Call the host-nation air defense artillery cell to coordinate the area, altitude block and times so they do not engage it.
scenarios.opener: Saya dari tim pengelola ruang udara. Unit saya akan terbang dengan drone pengawasan siang ini. Kita harus koordinasi area, blok ketinggian, dan waktu terbang. Bagaimana cara kita lakukan ini?
scenarios.openerEnglish: "I am from the airspace management team. Our unit will fly a surveillance drone this afternoon. We need to coordinate the area, altitude block, and flight times. How do we proceed?"

scenarios.title: Entry control point incident with a local national
scenarios.situation: A local delivery driver arrives at the gate without a valid pass and becomes upset. Explain politely why he cannot enter, what he needs, and offer to call his contact on base.
scenarios.opener: Kenapa saya tidak bisa masuk? Saya sudah datang dengan barang kiriman ini.
scenarios.openerEnglish: "Why can't I enter? I came with this delivery."

scenarios.title: Joint perimeter patrol brief
scenarios.situation: You lead tonight's joint perimeter patrol with host-nation soldiers. Brief their team leader on the route, check-in times, radio frequencies and what to do if you find a drone launch point.
scenarios.opener: Malam ini kita akan melakukan patrul bersama. Saya akan menjelaskan rute, waktu check-in, frekuensi radio, dan apa yang harus dilakukan jika kita menemukan titik peluncuran drone. Ada yang ingin ditanyakan?
scenarios.openerEnglish: "Tonight we will conduct a joint patrol. I will explain the route, check-in times, radio frequencies, and what to do if we find a drone launch point. Any questions?"

scenarios.title: Post-incident debrief
scenarios.situation: After a night drone incursion, sit down with your host-nation counterpart to go over what happened, what worked, and what both sides will change.
scenarios.opener: Mari kita bahas insiden drone malam ini. Apa yang terjadi, apa yang berfungsi, dan apa yang harus kitaubah di kedua sisi. Ayo mulai dari awal.
scenarios.openerEnglish: "Let's discuss the drone incursion last night. What happened, what worked, and what we need to change on both sides. Let's start from the beginning."

scenarios.title: Requesting a quick reaction force
scenarios.situation: Your team has found a person with a drone controller near the fence line. Call the host-nation operations center, give your location and request their quick reaction force.
scenarios.opener: Kota, ini Tim 2 di garis pagi. Kami menemukan seseorang dengan kontroler drone dekat pagar. Kami memerlukan Quick Reaction Force segera. Dimana mereka?
scenarios.openerEnglish: "Base, this is Team 2 at the morning line. We found someone with a drone controller near the fence. We need the Quick Reaction Force immediately. Where are they?"

scenarios.title: Explaining an FPCON change to a local contractor
scenarios.situation: The force protection condition has gone up. Explain to the local construction contractor's manager what changes for his workers tomorrow: arrival times, searches and escorts.
scenarios.opener: Tingkat FPCON telah naik. Besok ada perubahan untuk pekerja Anda: waktu kedatangan, pencarian, dan pengawalan. Apa yang ingin Anda tanyakan?
scenarios.openerEnglish: "The force protection condition has gone up. Tomorrow there will be changes for your workers: arrival times, searches, and escorts. What would you like to ask?"

scenarios.title: Coordinating a no-drone zone with municipal officials
scenarios.situation: A town festival is planned next to the base. Meet the municipal official to agree a no-drone zone notice for the public, who announces it, and how violations are handled.
scenarios.opener: Kita harus membuat pemberitahuan zona tanpa drone untuk festival kota ini. Siapa yang akan mengumumkan ini kepada umum, dan bagaimana kami menangani pelanggaran?
scenarios.openerEnglish: "We need to create a no-drone zone notice for this town festival. Who will announce this to the public, and how will we handle violations?"

scenarios.title: HADR drone-survey tasking
scenarios.situation: After floods, your team will fly survey drones for the host-nation disaster agency. Agree the areas, priorities, data sharing and safety rules with their coordinator.
scenarios.opener: Setelah banjir, tim saya akan terbang dengan drone survei untuk agen bencana Anda. Kita harus setuju area, prioritas, berbagi data, dan aturan keamanan. Ayo mulai.
scenarios.openerEnglish: "After the floods, our team will fly survey drones for your disaster agency. We need to agree on the areas, priorities, data sharing, and safety rules. Let's start."

scenarios.title: Agreeing weapons control status with a host-nation C-UAS team
scenarios.situation: A drone swarm threat is expected tonight. Agree with the host-nation counter-drone team commander who holds engagement authority, the weapons control status, and how each side will avoid hitting friendly drones.
scenarios.opener: Terjadi ancaman serangga drone malam ini. Kita harus setuju siapa yang memiliki otoritas penyenggaman, status kontrol senjata, dan bagaimana kami menghindari menembak drone teman. Apa pendapat Anda?
scenarios.openerEnglish: "There is a drone swarm threat tonight. We need to agree on who holds engagement authority, the weapons control status, and how we avoid hitting friendly drones. What is your opinion?"

scenarios.title: Escorting a host-nation delegation through access control
scenarios.situation: A visiting host-nation delegation arrives for a briefing. Welcome them at the gate, explain the badge and escort rules, and walk them to the briefing room.
scenarios.partnerRole: Senior member of the visiting delegation
scenarios.opener: Selamat datang di basis. Saya akan menjelaskan aturan badge dan pengawalan. Kita akan menuju ke ruang briefing sekarang. Ada yang ingin Anda tanyakan?
scenarios.openerEnglish: "Welcome to the base. I will explain the badge and escort rules. We will head to the briefing room now. Do you have any questions?"

dialogues.title: Night Shift Changeover at the Base

lines.speaker: Pranata BDOC Masuk (Pranata BDOC Masuk, Laki-laki)
lines.text: Selamat malam, Letnan Satria. Apa kabar di Pusat Operasi Pertahanan Pangkalan ini malam?
lines.english: Good evening, Lieutenant Satria. What's the situation at the Base Defense Operations Center tonight?

lines.speaker: Pranata BDOC Keluar (Pranata BDOC Keluar, Perempuan)
lines.text: Selamat malam, Sersan Jaka. Malam ini tenang, tapi ada beberapa jejak yang perlu diperhatikan.
lines.english: Good evening, Sergeant Jaka. Tonight is quiet, but there are a few trails that need to be noted.

lines.speaker: Pranata BDOC Masuk (Pranata BDOC Masuk, Laki-laki)
lines.text: Bahaslah saya.
lines.english: Tell me.

lines.speaker: Pranata BDOC Keluar (Pranata BDOC Keluar, Perempuan)
lines.text: Kira-kira satu jam yang lalu, kami melaporkan penglihatan drone di sebelah barat pangkalan.
lines.english: About an hour ago, we reported a drone sighting on the west side of the base.

lines.speaker: Pranata BDOC Masuk (Pranata BDOC Masuk, Laki-laki)
lines.text: Drone itu melakukan apa?
lines.english: What was the drone doing?

lines.speaker: Pranata BDOC Keluar (Pranata BDOC Keluar, Perempuan)
lines.text: Hanya mengamati. Tidak ada tindakan agresif. Kami telah melaporkan ke komando.
lines.english: Just observing. No aggressive actions. We have reported to command.

lines.speaker: Pranata BDOC Masuk (Pranata BDOC Masuk, Laki-laki)
lines.text: Baik. Apa lagi?
lines.english: Okay. What else?

lines.speaker: Pranata BDOC Keluar (Pranata BDOC Keluar, Perempuan)
lines.text: Kamera gerbang utama sedang mengalami gangguan. Tim teknisi sedang memperbaikinya.
lines.english: The main gate camera is experiencing a fault. The technical team is fixing it.

lines.speaker: Pranata BDOC Masuk (Pranata BDOC Masuk, Laki-laki)
lines.text: Bagaimana dengan patroli malam?
lines.english: What about the night patrol?

lines.speaker: Pranata BDOC Keluar (Pranata BDOC Keluar, Perempuan)
lines.text: Patroli satu masih di luar. Mereka harus kembali dalam 30 menit.
lines.english: Patrol one is still out. They should be back in 30 minutes.

lines.speaker: Pranata BDOC Masuk (Pranata BDOC Masuk, Laki-laki)
lines.text: Terima kasih, Letnan Satria. Semoga malam ini lancar.
lines.english: Thank you, Lieutenant Satria. Hope the night goes smoothly.

lines.speaker: Pranata BDOC Keluar (Pranata BDOC Keluar, Perempuan)
lines.text: Terima kasih, Sersan Jaka. Jaga baik-baik pangkalan.
lines.english: Thank you, Sergeant Jaka. Take good care of the base.

lines.speaker: Prajurit Satria, voice male
lines.text: Pos Pengamatan Lima Lima Lima, untuk LT Lima Lima Lima Lima Lima Lima Lima Lima, laporan titik.
lines.english: Observation Post Five Five Five, to Duty Officer Five Five Five Five Five Five Five Five Five, report.

lines.speaker: LT Surya, voice female
lines.text: Lima Lima Lima Lima Lima Lima Lima Lima Lima, untuk Pos Pengamatan Lima Lima Lima, silakan dilanjutkan.
lines.english: Five Five Five Five Five Five Five Five Five, to Observation Post Five Five Five, please continue.

lines.speaker: Prajurit Satria
lines.text: Pos Pengamatan Lima Lima Lima, melihat drone multirotor berukuran kecil mengapung di atas titik bahan bakar.
lines.english: Observation Post Five Five Five, observing a small multirotor drone hovering over the fuel point.

lines.speaker: Prajurit Satria
lines.text: Drone itu berada sekitar 200 meter sebelah barat daya dari titik bahan bakar.
lines.english: The drone is approximately 200 meters southwest of the fuel point.

lines.speaker: Prajurit Satria
lines.text: Arah geraknya tidak terbaca, tapi kami akan memantau lebih lanjut.
lines.english: Direction of movement is not discernible, but we will continue to monitor.

lines.speaker: LT Surya
lines.text: Terima kasih, Pos Pengamatan Lima Lima Lima. Lakukan pemantauan yang lebih dekat dan laporkan jika ada perubahan.
lines.english: Thank you, Observation Post Five Five Five. Conduct closer monitoring and report if there are any changes.

lines.speaker: Prajurit Satria
lines.text: Sembarang perintah lain, LT?
lines.english: Any other orders, Duty Officer?

lines.speaker: LT Surya
lines.text: Tidak, untuk saat ini. Selamat melaksanakan tugas.
lines.english: None, for now. Good luck with your duty.

lines.speaker: Prajurit Satria
lines.text: Pos Pengamatan Lima Lima Lima, selesai.
lines.english: Observation Post Five Five Five, out.

lines.speaker: Pemangku Ruang Udara Satuan, John (Pria, Suara Amerika)
lines.text: Selamat siang, ini John dari Satuan 321. Saya ingin mengkoordinasikan penggunaan ruang udara dengan Tim SPU Anda.
lines.english: Good morning, this is John from Unit 321. I want to coordinate airspace usage with your SPU team.

lines.speaker: Perwira Hubungan SPU TNI-AU, Rina (Wanita, Suara Indonesia)
lines.text: Selamat siang, John. Saya Rina. Silakan lanjutkan.
lines.english: Good morning, John. I'm Rina. Please proceed.

lines.speaker: Pemangku Ruang Udara Satuan, John (Pria, Suara Amerika)
lines.text: Kami akan melaksanakan penerbangaan dengan drone pengawasan kecil pada siang ini. Kami butuh koordinasi untuk ruang udara, blok ketinggian, dan waktu.
lines.english: We will be conducting a small surveillance drone flight this afternoon. We need coordination for airspace, altitude block, and time.

lines.speaker: Perwira Hubungan SPU TNI-AU, Rina (Wanita, Suara Indonesia)
lines.text: Baik, John. Berapa blok ketinggian yang Anda butuhkan?
lines.english: Alright, John. What altitude block do you need?

lines.speaker: Pemangku Ruang Udara Satuan, John (Pria, Suara Amerika)
lines.text: Kami memerlukan blok ketinggian 500 hingga 1000 kaki.
lines.english: We need an altitude block from 500 to 1000 feet.

lines.speaker: Perwira Hubungan SPU TNI-AU, Rina (Wanita, Suara Indonesia)
lines.text: Dan waktu penerbangan Anda?
lines.english: And what are your flight times?

lines.speaker: Pemangku Ruang Udara Satuan, John (Pria, Suara Amerika)
lines.text: Kami akan mulai pada pukul 13.00 dan selesai pada pukul 16.00.
lines.english: We will start at 1300 hours and finish at 1600 hours.

lines.speaker: Perwira Hubungan SPU TNI-AU, Rina (Wanita, Suara Indonesia)
lines.text: Terima kasih, John. Kami akan mengkoordinasikan dengan tim SPU kami. Saya akan kembali ke Anda jika ada masalah.
lines.english: Thank you, John. We will coordinate with our SPU team. I will get back to you if there are any issues.

lines.speaker: Pemangku Ruang Udara Satuan, John (Pria, Suara Amerika)
lines.text: Saya mengapresiasi bantuan Anda, Rina. Terima kasih.
lines.english: I appreciate your help, Rina. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Pemimpin Patroli (Pria, Suara Tenor)
lines.text: Saudara Letnan, malam ini kita akan melakukan patroli bersama di sekitar basis. Kita akan memulai dari titik A dan berakhir di titik B.
lines.english: Lieutenant, tonight we will conduct a joint patrol around the base. We will start from point A and end at point B.

lines.speaker: Pemimpin Tim TNI-AU (Wanita, Suara Alto)
lines.text: Baik, Sersan. Berapa lama patroli ini akan berlangsung?
lines.english: Okay, Sergeant. How long will this patrol last?

lines.speaker: Pemimpin Patroli (Pria, Suara Tenor)
lines.text: Kira-kira empat jam. Kita akan menghentikan di tiap titik check-in setiap 30 menit. Nama panggilan saya 'Elang', dan nama panggilan Saudara apa?
lines.english: Approximately four hours. We will stop at each check-in point every 30 minutes. My call sign is 'Elang', and what is your call sign?

lines.speaker: Pemimpin Tim TNI-AU (Wanita, Suara Alto)
lines.text: Nama panggilan saya 'Harimau'. Frekuensi radio yang akan kita gunakan apa?
lines.english: My call sign is 'Harimau'. What radio frequency will we use?

lines.speaker: Pemimpin Patroli (Pria, Suara Tenor)
lines.text: Frekuensi radio kita adalah 123.45 MHz. Jika kita menemukan titik peluncuran drone, kita akan melaporkan ke komando dan menandai lokasi dengan penanda GPS.
lines.english: Our radio frequency is 123.45 MHz. If we find a drone launch point, we will report to command and mark the location with a GPS marker.

lines.speaker: Pemimpin Tim TNI-AU (Wanita, Suara Alto)
lines.text: Baik, Sersan. Apakah kita akan memiliki dukungan udara jika perlu?
lines.english: Okay, Sergeant. Will we have air support if needed?

lines.speaker: Pemimpin Patroli (Pria, Suara Tenor)
lines.text: Iya, tim dukungan udara siap di basis. Kita bisa menghubungi mereka melalui frekuensi radio yang sama.
lines.english: Yes, the air support team is ready at the base. We can contact them through the same radio frequency.

lines.speaker: Pemimpin Tim TNI-AU (Wanita, Suara Alto)
lines.text: Terima kasih, Sersan. Kita siap untuk memulai patroli.
lines.english: Thank you, Sergeant. We are ready to start the patrol.

lines.speaker: Pemimpin Patroli (Pria, Suara Tenor)
lines.text: Baik, mari kita mulai. Selamat malam dan tetap waspada.
lines.english: Okay, let's start. Good night and stay alert.

lines.speaker: Kepala Keamanan Penerbangan (Lt. Kol. John Smith, suara laki-laki)
lines.text: Selamat pagi, Kolonel Yasmin. Terima kasih sudah datang. Saya ingin melakukan tinjauan pasca aksi tentang insiden drone kemarin malam.
lines.english: Good morning, Colonel Yasmin. Thank you for coming. I would like to conduct an after-action review of last night's drone incident.

lines.speaker: Perwira Keamanan Negara Penerbangan (Kol. Yasmin, suara perempuan)
lines.text: Selamat pagi, John. Saya setuju. Insiden ini memberikan pelajaran yang dipelajari bagi keduanya.
lines.english: Good morning, John. I agree. This incident provides lessons learned for both of us.

lines.speaker: Kepala Keamanan Penerbangan
lines.text: Betul. Saya lihat bahwa sistem deteksi Anda bekerja dengan baik, tetapi ada beberapa hal yang bisa kami perbaiki.
lines.english: Indeed. I see that your detection system worked well, but there are some things we can improve.

lines.speaker: Perwira Keamanan Negara Penerbangan
lines.text: Ya, sistem deteksi kami mendeteksi drone itu tapi kami mengalami kesulitan untuk mengejarnya.
lines.english: Yes, our detection system detected the drone but we had difficulty chasing it.

lines.speaker: Kepala Keamanan Penerbangan
lines.text: Kami juga mengalami masalah yang sama. Kami akan meningkatkan koordinasi antara unit deteksi dan unit pengejaran.
lines.english: We had the same problem. We will improve the coordination between the detection unit and the pursuit unit.

lines.speaker: Perwira Keamanan Negara Penerbangan
lines.text: Itu baik. Kami juga akan meningkatkan pelatihan kami untuk meningkatkan respons kami.
lines.english: That's good. We will also improve our training to enhance our response.

lines.speaker: Kepala Keamanan Penerbangan
lines.text: Saya setuju. Kami juga akan berbagi informasi lebih baik dan lebih cepat di masa depan.
lines.english: I agree. We will also share information better and faster in the future.

lines.speaker: Perwira Keamanan Negara Penerbangan
lines.text: Baik, saya setuju dengan rencana tersebut. Terima kasih atas kerjasama Anda, John.
lines.english: Alright, I agree with that plan. Thank you for your cooperation, John.

lines.speaker: Kepala Keamanan Penerbangan
lines.text: Terima kasih, Yasmin. Saya harap kita bisa bekerja sama lebih baik di masa depan.
lines.english: Thank you, Yasmin. I hope we can work together better in the future.

lines.speaker: Pemimpin Tim (Laki-laki, US Service Member)
lines.text: Halo, inilah Pusat Operasi TNI-AU? Saya Letnan Satria dari Tim Eagle, Skuadron 321.
lines.english: Hello, is this the TNI-AU Operations Center? This is Lieutenant Satria from Team Eagle, Squadron 321.

lines.speaker: Pusat Operasi TNI-AU (Perempuan, TNI-AU)
lines.text: Ya, ini Pusat Operasi TNI-AU. Apa yang bisa kami bantu, Letnan?
lines.english: Yes, this is the TNI-AU Operations Center. How can we assist you, Lieutenant?

lines.speaker: Pemimpin Tim (Laki-laki, US Service Member)
lines.text: Kami menemukan seorang pria dengan kontroler drone dekat pagar, di referensi grid 14 S 234 812.
lines.english: We have found a man with a drone controller near the fence, at grid reference 14 S 234 812.

lines.speaker: Pusat Operasi TNI-AU (Perempuan, TNI-AU)
lines.text: Terima kasih atas informasi tersebut. Apakah Anda memerlukan bantuan?
lines.english: Thank you for the information. Do you need assistance?

lines.speaker: Pemimpin Tim (Laki-laki, US Service Member)
lines.text: Ya, kami memerlukan kekuatan reaksi cepat di lokasi operator drone ini.
lines.english: Yes, we require a quick reaction force at the drone operator's location.

lines.speaker: Pusat Operasi TNI-AU (Perempuan, TNI-AU)
lines.text: Baik, kami akan segera mengirimkan pasukan. Apakah ada lagi yang perlu kita ketahui?
lines.english: Roger, we will dispatch troops immediately. Is there anything else we need to know?

lines.speaker: Pemimpin Tim (Laki-laki, US Service Member)
lines.text: Pria ini terlihat mengenakan seragam militer, tetapi kami tidak dapat mengidentifikasi divisi.
lines.english: The man appears to be wearing military uniform, but we cannot identify the division.

lines.speaker: Pusat Operasi TNI-AU (Perempuan, TNI-AU)
lines.text: Terima kasih. Kami akan menyampaikan informasi ini kepada pasukan. Selamat malam dan hati-hati.
lines.english: Thank you. We will pass this information to the troops. Good night and be careful.

lines.speaker: Pemimpin Tim (Laki-laki, US Service Member)
lines.text: Terima kasih, selamat malam.
lines.english: Thank you, good night.

lines.speaker: Karen (Perawat Keamanan Instalasi, female)
lines.text: Pak Jono, besok kondisi perlindungan kekuatan naik ke Level Bravo.
lines.english: Mr. Jono, tomorrow the force protection condition will increase to Level Bravo.

lines.speaker: Jono (Manajer Konstruksi Lokal, male)
lines.text: Baik, pak. Apa yang berubah untuk tim saya?
lines.english: Understood, ma'am. What changes for my team?

lines.speaker: Karen (Perawat Keamanan Instalasi, female)
lines.text: Pertama, semua pekerja harus tiba sebelum pukul 06.00. Tidak ada pengecualian.
lines.english: First, all workers must arrive before 0600 hours. No exceptions.

lines.speaker: Jono (Manajer Konstruksi Lokal, male)
lines.text: Baik, pak. Apa lagi?
lines.english: Understood, ma'am. What else?

lines.speaker: Karen (Perawat Keamanan Instalasi, female)
lines.text: Kedua, semua kendaraan harus melalui area pemeriksaan kendaraan sebelum masuk ke dalam basis.
lines.english: Second, all vehicles must go through the vehicle search area before entering the base.

lines.speaker: Jono (Manajer Konstruksi Lokal, male)
lines.text: Baik, pak. Apa yang harus mereka bawa?
lines.english: Understood, ma'am. What should they bring?

lines.speaker: Karen (Perawat Keamanan Instalasi, female)
lines.text: Mereka harus membawa identifikasi mereka dan daftar kehadiran.
lines.english: They must bring their identification and attendance list.

lines.speaker: Jono (Manajer Konstruksi Lokal, male)
lines.text: Baik, pak. Terima kasih atas informasinya.
lines.english: Understood, ma'am. Thank you for the information.

lines.speaker: Karen (Perawat Keamanan Instalasi, female)
lines.text: Sama-sama, Pak Jono. Jaga tim Anda selamat.
lines.english: You're welcome, Mr. Jono. Keep your team safe.

lines.speaker: Prajurit Pertama Siti
lines.text: Selamat pagi, Pak. Apa yang bisa Saya bantu?
lines.english: Good morning, Sir. How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Supir Pengiriman Jono
lines.text: Selamat pagi. Saya Jono dari JNE. Saya mau masuk ke dalam untuk mengantarkan paket.
lines.english: Good morning. I'm Jono from JNE. I want to enter to deliver a package.

lines.speaker: Prajurit Pertama Siti
lines.text: Maaf Pak, saya tidak melihat passport masuk Anda di titik kontrol masuk. Anda membutuhkan passport untuk masuk ke dalam.
lines.english: Sorry Sir, I don't see your entry pass at the control point. You need a pass to enter.

lines.speaker: Supir Pengiriman Jono
lines.text: Passport? Tapi saya selalu masuk tanpa passport! Ini tidak masuk akal!
lines.english: Pass? But I always enter without a pass! This doesn't make sense!

lines.speaker: Prajurit Pertama Siti
lines.text: Saya mengerti ketidaknyamanan Anda, Pak. Tetapi aturan baru. Saya bisa menelepon kontak Anda di dalam jika Anda ingin.
lines.english: I understand your discomfort, Sir. But these are the new rules. I can call your contact inside if you'd like.

lines.speaker: Supir Pengiriman Jono
lines.text: Ya, silakan. Nomor Kapten Prasetya. Saya tidak mengerti mengapa mereka tidak memberitahu saya tentang passport baru.
lines.english: Yes, please. Captain Prasetya's number. I don't understand why they didn't tell me about the new pass.

lines.speaker: Prajurit Pertama Siti
lines.text: Tidak masalah, Pak. Saya akan menelepon sekarang. Harap bersabar sebentar.
lines.english: No problem, Sir. I will call now. Please wait a moment.

lines.speaker: Supir Pengiriman Jono
lines.text: Terima kasih. Saya hanya frustrasi karena ini mengganggu rute saya hari ini.
lines.english: Thank you. I'm just frustrated because this disrupts my route today.

lines.speaker: Prajurit Pertama Siti
lines.text: Saya mengerti, Pak. Saya akan segera menyelesaikan ini.
lines.english: I understand, Sir. I will resolve this quickly.
